instruction.text: Vervollständige Tobys Bericht über sein Eishockey-Spiel, indem du die passenden Wörter auswählst.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>ice hockey rink</voice> bedeutet Eishockeyspielfeld

atoms.b: Today was an important day. My ((++ice_hockey ice_skating skiing)) team not only had a match against our rival team, but it also was the last game of this year's ((++competition celebration)) season. However, everything almost went wrong before it even started. My dad had the wrong address of the ((++stadium ski_slope)), so we drove to the wrong location. But he called the parents of my ((++teammate classmate)) and they gave us the right directions. Eventually, we found our way to the ice-hockey ((++rink court pitch field)).
atoms.sound: Today was an important day. My ice hockey team not only had a match against our rival team, but it also was the last game of this years competition. However, everything almost went wrong before it even started. My dad had the wrong address of the stadium, so we drove to the wrong location. But he called the parents of my teammate and they gave us the right directions. Eventually, we found our way to the ice hockey rink.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text, indem du die passenden Wörter auswählst.

atoms.b: At the stadium, I realised that I forgot my ((++ice_skates running_shoes)) at home. Before the match, my sister helped me pack my bag for the game. First, I put my black ((++helmet swimming_trunks)) and my favourite ice hockey ((++stick racket bat)) in the bag. Then, my sister gave me my knee and shoulder ((++pads saddles)). However, no one remembered to pack my ice skates. Luckily, I could borrow a pair of skates at the stadium.
atoms.sound: At the stadium, I realised that I forgot my ice skates at home. Before the match, my sister helped me pack my bag for the game. First, I put my black helmet and my favourite ice hockey stick in the bag. Then, my sister gave me my knee and shoulder pads. However, no one remembered to pack my ice skates. Luckily, I could borrow a pair of skates at the stadium.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text, indem du die passenden Wörter auswählst.

atoms.b: First, the other team was in the ((++lead last)). Being the ((++captain cheerleader)) of my team, I motivated my teammates not to give up. We shouldn't lose our hopes because we ((++trained surfed)) so much over the last year. Therefore, we were successful in the end and ((++won lost)) the competition. I even achieved the last ((++goal playtime)). As a team, we got a ((++trophy helmet)) and every team member got a ((++medal ball)) too.
atoms.sound: Then, the other team was in the lead at the beginning. As the captain of my team, I motivated my teammates not to give up. We shouldn't lose our hopes, because we trained so much over the last year. Therefore, we were successful in the end and won the competition. I even achieved the last goal. As a team, we got a trophy and every team member got a medal too.
